verdict.rationale: Dynamic Routing lets you build visual or JSON routing flows that support A/B tests and gradual rollouts, which implies percentage or weight-style traffic splits across models. It also chooses models by conditions and quotas, with fallbacks on errors or timeouts. Nothing shows load-balancing driven by latency or cost, or distribution across multiple API keys or deployments; fallbacks are failover, not balancing. Missing for 10: explicit weighted load-balancing docs, latency-based routing, cost-based routing, multi-key/deployment balancing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
